request.interests: waterfront, good food, something fun, low effort

stops.name: Domino Park
stops.why: Waterfront park on the old sugar refinery site with Manhattan skyline views; easy start a few blocks from Kent Ave.

stops.name: Time Out Market New York
stops.why: Food hall with many local kitchens under one roof, so two people with different cravings both win; rooftop has bridge views.
stops.hours: Sunday - Thursday: 8am – 10pm (individual kitchen times may vary)

stops.name: Jane's Carousel
stops.address: Empire Fulton Ferry, Brooklyn Bridge Park, DUMBO
stops.why: Restored 1922 carousel in a glass pavilion right under the Brooklyn Bridge; a fun ten minutes for adults too.
stops.hours: Fall hours Sep 14–Dec 31 2026: 11:00 AM-5:50 PM, closed Monday and Tuesday

stops.name: Brooklyn Bridge Park waterfront walk (Empire Fulton Ferry to Pier 1)
stops.why: Free, flat walk along the water with the best Manhattan and bridge views in Brooklyn; benches everywhere.

notes: Williamsburg to DUMBO: NYC Ferry or a 15-minute ride; check the ferry schedule the morning of, fare not verified here.
Brooklyn Brewery is temporarily closed per its site, so it's not on this plan.
Time Out Market kitchens keep their own hours; most are open at lunch.
